# `ext::websocket` — declaration reference

Generated source inventory. Linked guides own runtime and semantic contracts; a listed declaration does not establish executable behavior.

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../extended/ext/websocket.lani#L3)

Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Portable HTTP/1 upgrade request/response and extension-free frame/message processing. Response operations take a caller-computed canonical Accept for the original validated Request; no digest implementation or native crypto dependency lives here. Response validation requires HTTP/1.1 101, exact singleton Upgrade/Accept semantics, valid Connection tokens, at most one case-sensitive offered subprotocol and no negotiated extension; borrowed remaining bytes preserve the first-frame boundary. Response encoding stages a checked owned 101 head with explicit Vec destruction and no framing/body. Current direct Linux x86_64 contract execution covers 34 malformed responses plus valid/OWS/selection, stride, trailing-frame and encoder boundaries. Historical request/frame native groups retain their separate earlier source scope and were not rerun. The separate generic client-upgrade/frame-stream modules now preserve coalesced bytes over an exclusively borrowed transport, with their own scripted and real-client receipts. The borrowed server upgrade now pauses for caller policy before staging a response and has separate six-scenario and real echo-server receipts. Shared HTTP-server/scheduler adoption, formal proofs and automatic lifetime checking remain open.

```lanius
pub fn validate_response(input:core::slice::View<u8>, request:Request, expected_accept:core::slice::View<u8>, limits:Limits) -> core::result::Result<Response,Error>
```

Borrows a complete HTTP/1.1 101 response head against a live validated Request and externally computed canonical expected Accept. Returns borrowed head/optional offered protocol/remaining bytes, preserving all post-head input; performs no digest, allocation or transport handoff.

### function: encode_response

[Source line 439](../../../extended/ext/websocket.lani#L439)

```lanius
pub fn encode_response(request:Request, fields:core::slice::View<ext::http::Field>, accept:core::slice::View<u8>, protocol:core::option::Option<core::slice::View<u8>>, limits:Limits) -> core::result::Result<alloc::vec::Vec<u8>,Error>
```

Validates an externally computed canonical Accept and optional single offered protocol, rejects caller overrides of handshake/framing fields and emits one owned extension-free 101 head. Every error releases staging; success requires explicit Vec destruction. The caller must establish Accept belongs to request.key.
